body.label: Target
body.html: One detected enemy within 5 units; choose two empty spaces within 2 units of it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn. The chosen spaces become difficult terrain for that target only until the start of your next turn, representing anticipated pressure.

surges.html: A willing ally within 3 units may move 1 unit toward either space.
On a hit, the target is also Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When the target voluntarily avoids both marked spaces while moving before your next turn, make it Exposed and move yourself 1 unit toward either space.
